import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Queue;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;

        public Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static int INF = 1 << 29;
    static int MAXN = 500;
    static boolean[][] m = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] d = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAXN];
    static int n, xb, yb, t, temp[][] = new int[MAXN][MAXN], kaps[][] = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<Pair> l = new ArrayDeque<>();
        l.add(new Pair(0, new Pair(x1, y1)));
        int h[][] = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int p = 0; p < n; p++)
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++)
                h[p][b] = INF;
        while (!l.isEmpty()) {
            int v = l.peek().first, x = l.peek().second.first, y = l.peek().second.second;
            l.poll();
            h[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && m[x - 1][y] && h[x - 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1 && (x - 1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x - 1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1 || !(x - 1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x - 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x - 1, y)));
            }
            if (y > 0 && m[x][y - 1] && h[x][y - 1] > h[x][y] + 1 && (x == x2 && y - 1 == y2 && temp[x][y - 1] >= h[x][y] + 1 || !(x == x2 && y - 1 == y2) && temp[x][y - 1] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x, y - 1)));
            }
            if (x < n - 1 && m[x + 1][y] && h[x + 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1 && (x + 1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x + 1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1 || !(x + 1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x + 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x + 1, y)));
            }
            if (y < n - 1 && m[x][y + 1] && h[x][y + 1] > h[x][y] + 1 && (x == x2 && y + 1 == y2 && temp[x][y + 1] >= h[x][y] + 1 || !(x == x2 && y + 1 == y2) && temp[x][y + 1] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x, y + 1)));
            }
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
        g[a].add(e.size());
        e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size());
        e.add(e2);
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * n * 2 + 2; i++)
            d[i] = -1;
        d[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && d[n * n * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int j = 0; j < g[v].size(); j++) {
                int id = g[v].get(j), to = e.get(id).b;
                if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q.add(to);
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[n * n * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == n * n * 2 + 1) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]), to = e.get(id).b;
            if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed != 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        for (;;) {
            if (!bfs()) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n * n * 2 + 2; i++)
                ptr[i] = 0;
            while (int pushed = dfs(0, INF))
                flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] s = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(s[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(s[1]);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++)
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char x = br.readLine().charAt(0);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (x == 'Z') {
                    xb = i;
                    yb = j;
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else if (x == 'Y') m[i][j] = false; else m[i][j] = true;
                add_edge(0, i + 1, x == 'Z' || x == 'Y' ? 0 : x - 48);
            }
        }
        int k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char x = br.readLine().charAt(0);
                if (x >= '0' && x <= '9') kaps[i][j] = x - 48;
                add_edge(k++, n * n * 2 + 1, x == 'Z' || x == 'Y' ? 0 : x - 48);
            }
        Queue<Pair> l = new ArrayDeque<>();
        l.add(new Pair(0, new Pair(xb, yb)));
        while (!l.isEmpty()) {
            int v = l.peek().first, x = l.peek().second.first, y = l.peek().second.second;
            l.poll();
            temp[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x - 1][y] && m[x - 1][y]) l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x - 1, y)));
            if (y > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x][y - 1] && m[x][y - 1]) l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x, y - 1)));
            if (x < n - 1 && v + 1 < temp[x + 1][y] && m[x + 1][y]) l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x + 1, y)));
            if (y < n - 1 && v + 1 < temp[x][y + 1] && m[x][y + 1]) l.add(new Pair(v + 1, new Pair(x, y + 1)));
        }
        k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int k1 = n * n;
                k++;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++)
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        k1++;
                        if (m[i][j] && m[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t) add_edge(k, k1, INF);
                    }
            }
        pw.println(max_flow());
        pw.close();
    }
}
